dogecoin.text:
@QTRResearch And sadly, the price of a burger & fries isn't going to "correct" like a SPAC share or #dogecoin. It's the simple truth about more money chasing fewer goods: the fiat paper has to go somewhere. 

And consumer products are the last stop. Get your wheelbarrows ready! #stagflation

@APompliano So central governments *should* legislate their currencies?

Doesn't this just set the stage for continued distortion of money? I mean, if a government can mandate the use of #Bitcoin, they can also decide to mandate the use #etherium, #dogecoin, or [gasp] digital dollars! 🤔🤦‍♂️
